status: Context-reviewed proposed wording for combined integration; not yet in Android resources or verified on a device
decisions: These are the three remaining translatable entries in each locale at the pinned source. Both tooltip/settings variants deliberately say the same thing. Do not infer one-pixel-only width from historical key names.

Crisp describes edges with no antialiasing, not a straight line or one-pixel stroke. The width instruction uses the existing Size (px) localized label next to the pencil control. It preserves 1–100 as the inclusive range.

The labels remain Qillqana in both locales. Match the shipped pixel edge-smoothing labels for term and orthography: Southern Bolivian quh uses siq’iy and llamp’uyachiy; Ayacucho quy uses siqiy and llampuyachiy. Do not substitute the neighboring Cusco Lápiz wording.
Linguistic review covers source meaning, app behavior, orthography, and terminology. No native or device test was performed.

sources.detail: Peru MINEDU Southern Quechua pedagogical vocabulary, p. 35; siqiy/siq’iy as drawing; Chanka spelling distinction.
Herrero and Sánchez Cochabamba dictionary; llamp’uyachiy, used here for pixel edge smoothing in line with the shipped locale.

quh.source: Draw a crisp line. Adjust Width from 1 to 100 pixels.
quh.wording: Mana llamp'uyachisqa patayuq siq'ita siq'iy. «Chhikan (px)» nisqapi kinrayninta 1manta 100 pixelkama allichay.
quh.android_xml_value: Mana llamp\'uyachisqa patayuq siq\'ita siq\'iy. «Chhikan (px)» nisqapi kinrayninta 1manta 100 pixelkama allichay.
